label: Crowd captain excess (z)
gloss: how far the share of this coin’s cells that are captained sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; last 4 settled sessions; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or never or always captains
